descripcion_geo: Fertile coastal plain between Mount Carmel to the north and Jaffa to the south, famous for its natural beauty.
importancia_estrategica: The most fertile plain of Israel; Her proverbial beauty is a symbol of abundance and love in the Song.

historias.titulo: The Rose of Sharon in the Song
historias.descripcion: The beloved in the Song of Songs is described as 'the rose of Sharon and the lily of the valley'.
Solomon had Satri the Ishmaelite in charge of the flocks that grazed in Sharon.
After the healing of Aeneas in Lydda, all the inhabitants of Sharon saw the miracle and converted to the Lord.

personajes.descripcion: It is identified as 'the rose of Sharon'; symbol of the perfect beloved.
His miraculous ministry in Lydda reached the entire plain of Sharon.
His royal flocks grazed on the fertile plain of Sharon.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Plain of proverbial beauty; The 'Rose of Sharon' is one of the most evocative poems in the OT; in the NT, scene of coastal evangelization.

judaismo.descripcion: The rose of Sharon is a symbol of the beloved in the Song and of the people of Israel loved by God.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The rose of Sharon is a symbol of the beloved in the Song and of the people of Israel loved by God.

cristianismo.descripcion: The Fathers of the Church interpret the 'rose of Sharon' as Christ or the Virgin Mary.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Fathers of the Church interpret the 'rose of Sharon' as Christ or the Virgin Mary.
